name: kaufmann repetto
notes:
Verified via kaufmannrepetto.com/contact/ on 2026-08-17. Gallery also operates a Milan space (Via di Porta Tenaglia, 7, 20121 Milano MI, Italy) — out of scope for this NYC-only registry, not recorded as a venue. Shares 55 Walker St address with Bortolami and (per some secondary sources) Andrew Kreps — this Tribeca building appears to house multiple galleries; floor/suite not confirmed, flag for on-site verification.

Fingerprint (2026-08-18): wordpress — /wp-json/ reachable.

Bug found + fixed (2026-08-18): /exhibitions-current/ is a multi-location (Milan/New York/Hudson) tabbed slider, not a single current show — the generic current-page scraper was falling back to the page's generic SEO <title> tag ("Look into our current and upcoming exhibitions") with no artist. adapters/wordpress.ts now supports an optional wordpress.locationLabel to scope to the "new york" pane (.custom-navi/.content[data-swipe] slider markup, .author/.opera classes) — correctly resolves to "lily van der stokker — Male Art Exhibition, Great Show!" through Aug 8.

gallerypress (2026-08-18): verified live — wp-json category slug "press" (id 16, 43 posts). Real-world data is messy: several posts link only to a self-hosted PDF scan or have no outbound link at all (pure announcements) — adapters/gallerypress.ts drops those per SPEC.md §5.4 rather than guessing an outlet.
